correctness.rationale: The Paley(17) residue graph has 17 vertices, 68 edges, 68 triangles and no 4-clique. A specified 16-edge spanning tree yields 52 generators with 68 triangular relators. An independently reimplemented legal unique-occurrence Tietze elimination removes all 52 generators and leaves 16 empty relators, proving pi1=1, not merely H1=0. Euler characteristic and Hurewicz–Whitehead imply a wedge of sixteen S2. Independent affine signed simplicial traces for all 136 maps equal 16, -1, or 0 on identity, nontrivial translations, and nontrivial multipliers; this matches the 17-point augmentation module. Graph diameter two gives the exact Rips barcode.
residual_risks: Finite calculations certify only the specified finite objects or bounded corroboration; all-size claims depend on inspected arguments.

That result does not force trivial fundamental group or specify 136 affine character values. The legal Tietze sequence and complete character give a distinct homotopy and rational representation classification.

value.rationale: A nonabelian simply-connectedness certificate and full affine group module of a classical quadratic-residue flag complex are motivated invariants beyond known Betti counts. The order-17 case is a canonical finite benchmark and the barcode is a rigorous geometric corollary.
